accountCreated.subject: Murakaza neza kuri ShopCore

passwordReset.subject: Hindura ijambo ry'ibanga rya ShopCore

passwordReset.body: Twakiriye ubusabe bwo guhindura ijambo ry'ibanga rya konti yawe ya ShopCore. Hitamo irindi ukoresheje buto iri hasi. Iyi link irangira mu isaha imwe.

passwordChanged.subject: Ijambo ry'ibanga rya ShopCore ryahinduwe
passwordChanged.heading: Ijambo ry'ibanga ryahinduwe
passwordChanged.body: Ijambo ry'ibanga rya konti yawe ya ShopCore ryahinduwe neza. Ibindi bikoresho byose byasohotse. Niba atari wowe, hindura ijambo ry'ibanga ako kanya uhamagare ubufasha.

subscriptionActivated.subject: Kwiyandikisha kwawe kuri ShopCore birakora

subscriptionActivated.body: Kwiyandikisha kwawe kwa {{plan}} ubu birakora ku gihe cyo kwishyura cya {{cycle}} kuri {{workspace}}. Urakoze guhitamo ShopCore.
